tasks.short: Recommend measures protecting workers from hazardous methods, processes and materials

steps.what: Assess the actual work method, process or material hazard and affected workers
Select proportionate protective measures and evaluate feasibility and residual risk
Prepare the recommendation document using selected measures and verified hazard details
Explain recommendations and limitations to the responsible manager

tasks.design: Configure recommendation templates in {DOCS} to assemble only the specialist's selected measures and rationale. Assessment, control selection and explanation remain human; the template does not propose a safety verdict.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected measures and site details are repeatedly reformatted into advice documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can reuse checked content and preserve source references.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing effective controls for the actual work and residual risk.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding practical constraints and challenging inadequate controls.
tasks.altitude: Less document assembly; no change to safety judgement or implementation authority.

reach.task: Assess feasibility of an engineering control

evidence.claim: Assembling human-selected controls in a document template is an E1 design assumption; it does not automate hazard recognition.

assumptions: Boundary is specialist assessment and advice, excluding engineering design, implementation and management acceptance.

Specialist produces the hazard assessment in s1 and selected measures and residual-risk rationale in fully retained s2. S3's ten retained hours include capturing site, hazard, control text, owner recommendation and source references, plus meaning and omission checks; unclear content is written manually.
Test native templates first. Two incremental specialist hours per 100 baseline hours cover template and source-link checks.
unknowns: Current advice format and repeated document assembly effort
research_questions: Does templating save time after site-specific wording and meaning checks?

already_counted.description: First template capture and recommendation meaning checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90; gross10 less2 upkeep gives8 net. Novel controls can require full writing and yield minus2; assessment, selection and explanation retain80.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and maintain occupational hygiene programs

steps.what: Define hygiene-program scope, exposure concerns and required specialist surveys or monitoring
Compile and validate existing survey, atmosphere, ventilation and asbestos records relevant to program scope
Develop or revise the hygiene program using validated findings and applicable requirements
Maintain agreed survey dates, action owners and review reminders for the hygiene program

tasks.design: Configure a {OTHER} occupational hygiene register with source-linked survey records from {DOCS}. Use {PROJECT} reminders for explicitly agreed dates and owners while retaining exposure interpretation and program design with the specialist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program evidence and action dates can be spread across documents and spreadsheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Native registers and reminders reduce retrieval and repeated tracking.
tasks.still_hard: Survey validity, exposure interpretation and appropriate monitoring design.
tasks.human_edge: Judging whether evidence adequately represents actual exposure.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence assembly and tracking; survey and program responsibilities remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Source-linked hygiene records and agreed-action reminders are E1 design assumptions, not automated exposure assessments.
Dutch occupational safety law requires a written risk inventory and action plan; applicability to this organisation needs local review.

assumptions: Boundary is developing and maintaining the hygiene program, excluding laboratory analysis, specialist field surveys and continuous sensor runtime.

Existing survey providers produce report identifiers, dates, sites, units, methods and limitations during unchanged survey delivery. Specialist captures and verifies these in s2's fifteen retained hours; missing information returns for clarification without assumed automatic extraction.

Specialist produces program actions in s3 and captures agreed owner, due date, review interval and status in s4's 7.5 retained hours. No free compliance status or inferred due date is used; changed requirements are handled manually.
Test native registers and reminders first. Three incremental specialist hours per 100 baseline hours cover register structure and reminder checks.
unknowns: Program scope, survey formats and existing hygiene systems
research_questions: Does one evidence register reduce assembly after validity checks and action capture?

already_counted.description: Survey metadata capture and evidence validity checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R82.5; gross17.5 less3 upkeep gives14.5 net. Poor source records may leave only3 hours gained and zero net; program scope and design retain60.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate accidents and identify causes and prevention measures

steps.what: Inspect the accident context, interview people and preserve checked factual observations
Reconstruct a source-linked accident chronology and identify gaps or conflicting accounts

loop.purpose: Draft a factual chronology from checked investigation sources
loop.input: Source notes, authorised records and explicit uncertain facts
loop.output: Chronology with source references, conflicts and missing information
loop.check: Specialist verifies event meaning, source attribution, sequence and uncertainty against full accounts; absence of a note must not become absence of an event
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved contradictions return to manual reconstruction
loop.why_not_simpler: Native record ordering comes first, but witness prose and relative timing require contextual reading

steps.what: Determine supported causal factors and test alternative explanations against the evidence
Agree prevention recommendations and explain evidence limits to responsible managers

tasks.design: Organise checked sources in {DOCS}, then use a bounded {WORKFLOW} draft only for chronology preparation. The specialist verifies chronology, determines causes and agrees prevention recommendations; urgent safety actions and required reporting proceed through existing immediate routes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Chronology reconstruction repeats comparison of notes and accounts.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked narrative drafting can prepare a chronology without establishing causation.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting accounts, missing evidence and distinguishing causes from correlation.
tasks.human_edge: Independent investigation and testing explanations against physical reality.
tasks.altitude: Less chronology preparation; causal judgement and immediate safety duties remain.

reach.task: Test a proposed mechanical causal explanation

evidence.claim: Quentic Reporting Assistant drafts reports from notes, photos and voice recordings; this supports narrative preparation, not causal conclusions.
The chronology saving is an E1 task scenario.
Dutch serious-accident reporting obligations are immediate; draft preparation must not delay them.

assumptions: Boundary covers accident fact-finding, chronology, causal assessment and prevention discussion, excluding separate formal report production and statutory notification.

Specialist produces notes and checked source identities during fully retained s1; s2's fifteen retained hours include event extraction, first chronology capture, meaning checks and manual conflict handling. No structured cause code is provided free.
Test native record organisation before the bounded loop. No blame score or autonomous causal finding is introduced.
Three incremental specialist hours per 100 baseline hours cover source access, draft quality and chronology-template upkeep.
unknowns: Source quality, investigation complexity and current chronology effort
research_questions: Does chronology drafting save net time after checking sequence, meaning and contradictions?

already_counted.description: Chronology capture, semantic checks and reconstruction exceptions

incremental.description: Source access and chronology quality upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90; gross10 less3 upkeep gives7 net. Conflicting accounts may require complete manual reconstruction and yield minus3; investigation, causation and recommendations retain75.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate with engineers and physicians on hazardous-condition controls

steps.what: Prepare relevant hazard findings and the specific control question for engineering or medical consultation
Collaborate with engineers or physicians to choose suitable control or remedial measures
Coordinate agreed implementation and verify the control addresses the hazardous condition

tasks.design: Configure a consultation-brief template in {DOCS} drawing on selected {PROJECT} source records. Preserve collaboration and specialist follow-up; the software neither designs engineering controls nor makes medical decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Brief preparation can repeat copying of established hazard findings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and record links reduce repeated assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling engineering feasibility, medical advice and actual control effectiveness.
tasks.human_edge: Cross-professional discussion and verification at the workplace.
tasks.altitude: Less brief assembly; control decisions and site verification remain human.

evidence.claim: Source-linked consultation templates are an E1 design assumption; no digest case establishes collaboration savings.

assumptions: Boundary is specialist consultation preparation, collaboration and follow-up, excluding original hazard investigation and engineers' or physicians' unchanged work.

Specialist selects existing hazard sources and captures site, equipment, consultation question, recipient and information-sharing limits in s1's nine retained hours. Missing findings or permissions are handled manually; no free structured hazard verdict is assumed.
Test native templates first. Two incremental specialist hours per 100 baseline hours cover brief templates and source references; no labour is transferred to collaborators.
unknowns: Collaboration process, sharing limits and repeated preparation effort
research_questions: Does a source-linked brief save assembly time after relevance and sharing checks?

already_counted.description: Brief capture, source selection and sharing checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R94; gross6 less2 upkeep gives4 net. Novel cases can require full brief preparation and yield minus2; collaboration and follow-up retain85.

role.altitude: Reduce record and document preparation while retaining occupational safety assessment and control judgement.
reach: Validate exposure evidence with an occupational hygienist
Coordinate medical questions within confidentiality limits
role.ambitious_version: Arrive at safety decisions with traceable evidence and explicit uncertainty while maintaining site verification and immediate response duties.
